title: SunPath Installation and First Bill Timetable
content:
Two timetable figures govern a SunPath Solar Lease between installation and the first bill.

| Tier | Target from installation to permission to operate | From permission to operate to the first bill |
|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | 45 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | 45 calendar days | 30 calendar days |

**Permission-to-operate target** — the target number of calendar days from installation to permission to operate: 30 for the four smallest systems and 45 for the SunPath 6.4 kW and SunPath 8.0 kW systems.

**First bill** — the number of calendar days after the permission-to-operate date to the first bill: 30 for every size. The first bill date is the permission-to-operate date plus 30 calendar days.

**Hypothetical illustration.** If permission to operate were granted on 4 March, the first bill date would be 3 April, 30 calendar days later, whatever the size of the system.
